name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Strawberry Shortcake
description:
Sweet, creamy, and dessert-smooth. The Cheech & Chong Strawberry Shortcake D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Strawberry Shortcake serves up the classic: ripe, juicy strawberry up front layered over sweet cake and whipped-cream notes, finished with a smooth, buttery sweetness. It's an indulgent, dessert-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet and satisfying.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Strawberry Shortcake flavor — ripe strawberry with sweet cake and cream notes
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Strawberry Shortcake is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
